purpose: 虚构渡口的景别与层次教学；不是历史来源或节目生产素材

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original 16:9 horizontal painterly cinematic teaching image, NOT a panel or collage, no text or borders. Fictional quiet early-20th-century riverside ferry landing, no real historical person or event. A middle-aged Chinese female boat keeper in a faded indigo cotton jacket and dark tied-back hair waits beside a weathered mooring post, her right hand resting on a thick slack rope. Wide establishing composition: viewer looks along the jetty diagonally into the river. A cropped dark near boat gunwale at lower left establishes immediate foreground; the woman is in the middle distance on the right third, full figure readable with the rope and post; jetty planks and posts recede toward softly distant riverboats and the opposite bank. Large-scale spatial relationships matter more than facial detail. Warm pale morning side light cleanly separates the indigo-clad figure from the river; restrained blue-gray water and warm timber, textured confident brushwork, natural anatomy. Keep near wood, middle subject, and far shore at convincingly different distances through overlap, relative scale, perspective and diminishing contrast. Deep enough focus to read the jetty and boats; no artificial edge vignette, no gratuitous blur, no hanging branches. Calm waiting, clear composition, rich but restrained detail. This is the WIDE source composition in a shot-scale teaching set; do not turn it into a portrait.

Use case: illustration-story. Use the reference only to preserve the same fictional Chinese woman, her indigo clothing, morning riverside setting and painterly style. Create one NEW 16:9 horizontal MEDIUM SHOT composition of this moment, not a crop of the existing picture and not a collage. Move the viewpoint close beside the mooring post at her hand height, looking slightly upward across it: woman framed from waist to above the head on the right half; her right forearm, relaxed hand resting against the thick rope on the post, and her quiet profile looking out toward the river are all clearly readable together. The post and hand are near the center-right, her face in the upper-right, with comfortable room to the left in her looking direction. A little dark boat edge cuts into the lower-left immediate foreground; river and the same distant boat lie well behind her. Place woman, hand and rope in the useful clear focus plane; far boat and riverbank are gently softer but recognizable. Warm side light separates her silhouette from cooler blue-gray river, with distinct near/middle/far distances rather than a flat portrait backdrop. Natural hands, relaxed plausible weight, no added people. Keep all meaning-bearing face/hand/rope inside the frame with breathing room. No text, labels, borders, panels, no artificial bokeh discs. This source image teaches how a medium shot preserves a bodily relation while concentrating attention.

Use case: illustration-story. Use the reference to preserve the same woman's indigo cotton sleeve, hand, weathered mooring post, coarse coiled rope, warm morning light and painterly rendering. Produce ONE new 16:9 horizontal CLOSE-UP source composition, not a collage or panel: her relaxed right hand rests across the worn top edge of the timber mooring post, fingertips touching the sunlit wood; below it a single clear section of thick coiled rope runs diagonally across the lower middle. We see the hand, sleeve cuff, wood contact, and rope fibers at generous readable scale. The hand and contact surface are the sharpest focus plane, rope immediately below still clear; nearest rope edge can soften slightly, river and a single distant boat dissolve into gentle low-contrast shapes far behind. Frame no face and no full body; her cropped sleeve enters naturally from upper right, hand centered around x0.58 y0.4, post and rope remain comfortably inside frame, river negative space toward left. Give the skin, rope, wood distinct tactile textures, subtle uneven warm light, anatomically natural five-finger relaxed hand with no extra digits. Calm waiting expressed through the still hand, not dramatic gripping. No text, labels, borders, panels, montage, no branch decorations, no artificial blur vignette. A coherent complete close-up image, rich near/far depth and carefully selected clarity. Do not zoom out to include the person or environment merely for completeness.
